# AI Sabotage: Cyber Cards

> AI Sabotage: Cyber Cards is a fast-paced cyberpunk strategy card game where up to 4 players duel to construct an Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) rig while tactically sabotaging their rivals. Matches take approximately three minutes. Available free on iOS and Android.

## Core Game Overview

- **Objective**: Be the first operator to assemble four distinct, healthy components in your AGI rig, or substitute missing slots using the Quantum Core wildcard.
- **Match Length**: ~3 minutes of rapid set collection and cyber sabotage.
- **Players**: 2–4 players across online, local hot-seat, or private match modes.
- **Offline Capable**: Full offline single-player mode vs CPU and local hot-seat on a single phone or tablet with zero internet required.

## The AGI Rig Architecture

An operational AGI requires 4 healthy component slots:
1. **Hardware [01]**: High-density quantum tensor processing clusters.
2. **Dataset [02]**: Petabyte neural training corpus and clean token pipelines.
3. **Neural Net [03]**: Deep transformer architecture and cognitive synaptic graphs.
4. **Algorithm [04]**: Self-optimizing reinforcement learning logic.
- **Wildcard (Quantum Core)**: Substitutes for any missing component slot.

## Tactical Card Types (54-Card Shared Deck)

- **Components**: Installed into empty slots on your rig.
- **Threats**: Targeted malware played onto rival components. The first threat infects the slot; a second threat of matching type destroys the entire stack to the discard pile.
- **Defenses**: Firewalls that protect components. One defense absorbs an incoming threat; two defenses permanently lock the component against all future threats.
- **Special Protocols**: Instant tactical programs:
  - *Data Heist*: Steal an un-locked component from a rival rig.
  - *EMP Purge*: Force an opponent to discard their entire hand.
  - *System Override*: Swap your entire rig with a rival's rig.
  - *Protocol Swap*: Exchange any two cards between players or slots.
  - *Malware Migration*: Move an active threat from your rig onto a rival component.

## Key Pages & Documentation

- [Rig Architecture Guide](https://aisabotage.store/en/rig): Deep-dive into rig slots, defensive locks, and win conditions.
- [Card Database & Reference](https://aisabotage.store/en/cards): Full directory of all 20 distinct cards across Components, Threats, Defenses, and Protocols.
- [Private Matches with Friends](https://aisabotage.store/en/friends): Guide for creating and joining private lobbies using 6-character room codes.
- [Global Ranking Ladder](https://aisabotage.store/en/ranking): Competitive ladder tiers (Novice, Script Kiddie, Netrunner, Cyber Overlord) and +10 PTS victory scoring.
- [Download & System Requirements](https://aisabotage.store/en/play): Technical requirements (iOS 14+, Android 9+) and feature breakdown.
- [Cyber Deck Blog & Strategy Hub](https://aisabotage.store/en/blog): Articles and tactical guides for AI Sabotage.
  - [Developing Strategic Thinking: How Strategy Card Games Train Executive Function](https://aisabotage.store/en/blog-cognitive-strategy-kids): Neuroscience and cognitive research on set collection, working memory, and tactical foresight.
  - [Competitive Ladder Tactics: How to Win Duels and Top the Ranking Ladder](https://aisabotage.store/en/blog-competitive-ladder-guide): Component locking, tempo economics, and protocol sequencing to reach Cyber Overlord tier.
  - [The Digital Tabletop Evolution: How Board Games Connected the World](https://aisabotage.store/en/blog-digital-board-games-connectivity): The transition from physical cardboard to mobile strategy duels and cross-border connectivity.
